common: Create ONE standalone improved pixel-art asset concept for Goat Out. Image 1 is chosen style reference only; image 2 if supplied is original subject reference. Preserve identity of specified subject. One object only centered, complete silhouette, generous margin, flat solid #2b2622 background, no text, no panels, no other objects. Match chunky charming sinister dungeon pixel art of reference 1, upper-left warm light, cooler plum shadows, connected clean pixel clusters, 4-5 shades per material, hard square edges, no blur, no smooth gradients or tiny noisy textures. Three-quarter game view unless original demands otherwise. Treat as 32-40 art-pixel character, props proportionally simple, enlarged with nearest-neighbor appearance. Improvements: stronger silhouette, separated limbs/tools, simplified shading and textures.
